moves.integration_points: New core tool group 'delegation' in src/butlers/core_tools/ (registered on domain butlers, gated by the existing CROSS_BUTLER_PERMISSION matrix check pattern at _switchboard.py:360): ask_butler(butler, question, deadline_s) and answer_delegation(delegation_id, answer). New public.delegations table (id, requestor_butler, target_butler, question, status pending/answered/expired, answer JSONB, request_id for trace spine, expires_at) in the core Alembic chain. Switchboard carries the ask as a route.v1 envelope (reusing _switchboard_route); on answer or expiry, the requestor's daemon schedules a one-shot prompt dispatch (existing scheduler, dispatch_mode='prompt') carrying the answer. New spec openspec/specs/cross-butler-delegation/; RFC amending roster/switchboard/MANIFESTO.md. Dashboard: delegations render on One Timeline keyed by request_id.
moves.slice_plan: Slice 1: public.delegations table + ask_butler/answer_delegation tools + Switchboard brokering, answers visible via bd-style status polling only. Slice 2: follow-up re-spawn on answer/expiry. Slice 3: timeline lane + drill-down on the dashboard.

moves.title: Domain-event subscriptions: typed cross-butler pub/sub on the entity spine
moves.why: Replaces 'anticipate every cross-domain join in one extraction prompt' with durable declared interest: relationship subscribes to any event carrying an entity_id it tracks; health subscribes to travel.trip_created to prep medications for time abroad. This is what genuinely collaborating butlers accomplish that none can alone — standing awareness across domains without schema access. Serves relationship ('a friend who never forgets'), health, and travel manifestos; the memory_catalog's entity_id columns already provide the join key.
moves.integration_points: New public.domain_events table (id, event_type e.g. 'finance.transaction_recorded', origin_butler, entity_id nullable FK public.entities, payload JSONB, request_id, created_at) and public.event_subscriptions (subscriber_butler, event_type pattern, predicate JSONB e.g. entity-tracked-only, seeded from a [butler.subscriptions] block in roster/*/butler.toml). Publish is a plain public-schema write from domain jobs/tools (same sanctioned pattern as roster/health/jobs/health_jobs.py:152's broker import). Delivery is a Switchboard scheduled job that batches matched events per subscriber and dispatches via existing route_to_butler (_switchboard.py:326) — MCP-only doctrine preserved. New spec cross-butler-subscriptions; RFC required (extends RFC 0009/0011 lineage).
moves.slice_plan: Slice 1: tables + publish helper + 3 pilot event types (finance.transaction_recorded, travel.trip_created, health.symptom_logged). Slice 2: Switchboard matcher/delivery job with per-subscriber batching + daily cap. Slice 3: butler.toml-seeded subscriptions + dashboard 'subscriptions' governance panel under Trust Console.

moves.title: Fleet attention arbiter: one egress ledger for all proactive owner contact
moves.why: Extends RFC 0011's structural anti-spam from insights-only to every proactive ping. Two butlers wanting the owner in the same window become one composed message in the Dispatch voice; a global interrupt budget makes calm earned at the phone, not just the console. Builds beyond bu-24lu6 (which adds pushes) and the known calendar double-notify mitigation (which patched one butler): this is the missing structural layer. Amends the Messenger and Switchboard infrastructure contracts.
moves.integration_points: Generalize public.insight_candidates into a public.attention_ledger (or sibling table): notify(intent='send') from non-interactive contexts (no request_context — the scheduled-task path distinguished today in src/butlers/core_tools/_notifications.py) writes a delivery intent instead of dispatching; a Messenger/Switchboard arbiter job (extending roster/switchboard/modules/insight_broker.py's cycle) coalesces same-window intents, ranks via the RFC 0011 priority convention, and delivers one composed message. priority='high' and interactive reply/react bypass unchanged. Spec deltas: core-notify, proactive-insight-engine, insight-delivery; RFC amending RFC 0011. Dashboard: ledger rows drill down from One Timeline via request_id.
moves.slice_plan: Slice 1: ledger table + notify send-path park-and-record behind a per-butler opt-in flag, arbiter delivers verbatim (no coalescing) within 5-min windows. Slice 2: coalescing + global daily interrupt budget + composed multi-butler digest. Slice 3: flip default on for all scheduled-task notify sends; retire per-butler ad-hoc dedup patches.

moves.title: Cross-domain case files: one shared object binding a multi-butler investigation
moves.why: The 'health notices a symptom, finance sees the pharmacy charge, relationship knows the doctor' story needs a durable spine object, or the three threads live and die separately in three schemas. A case binds fan-out segments, delegations (move 1), and events (move 2) into one trace-spined story that the console's One Timeline and the daily brief render as a single narrative with a synthesized outcome. No manifesto owns cross-domain narratives today — this implies a Switchboard contract amendment (case custody) with the opening butler owning synthesis.
moves.integration_points: New public.cases (id, title, opened_by_butler, status open/synthesized/closed, outcome TEXT, request_id) + public.case_items (case_id, kind fanout_segment/delegation/domain_event/fact_ref, source_butler, ref_id, request_id). Attach case_id at the Switchboard fan-out point (conversation-decomposition / _process_ingested_message in src/butlers/core_tools/_switchboard.py:280-320) when extraction targets ≥2 butlers; delegation and event rows (moves 1-2) carry case_id forward. Synthesis: the opening butler gets a scheduled check-back prompt when all case items resolve. Dashboard: case lane on One Timeline (epic bu-86c4c.9/.10 spine), case card in the daily brief. New spec cross-butler-case-files.
moves.slice_plan: Slice 1: tables + auto-open on multi-butler fan-out + read-only dashboard case view over existing request_id joins. Slice 2: delegation/event linkage + synthesis check-back. Slice 3: daily-brief case section replacing the string-collision 'Heads-up' clause.

moves.title: Session-side insight proposals: register propose_insight on every domain butler
moves.why: Repairs the doctrine inversion (finding 6) with almost no new machinery: the sessions where judgment lives get a governed path into the existing broker, so a mid-conversation realization competes for delivery under budget/cooldown/dedup instead of bypassing via notify() or being lost. Serves every domain manifesto's proactive promise ('we surface what is urgent') and strengthens move 3 by pulling more egress under the broker.
moves.integration_points: New core tool group 'insights' in src/butlers/core_tools/ registered on domain butlers (butler_type == BUTLER guard, same pattern as _temporal.py), thin wrapper over the existing plain function butlers.tools.switchboard.insight.broker.propose_insight_candidate (already a sanctioned public-schema write, per roster/health/jobs/health_jobs.py:152 precedent) with origin_butler forced to the calling butler. Spec delta: proactive-insight-engine 'Insight Candidate Submission' requirement (currently Switchboard-tool-only). Docstring must teach priority ranges and dedup_key discipline per the RFC 0011 convention.
moves.slice_plan: Single slice: tool + tests + spec delta; pilot on health and relationship, then fleet-wide via core_groups.

audits.jarvis_gap: The doctrine for proactivity is world-class on paper — RFC 0011's brokered insight engine (budget, dedup, cooldowns, adaptive one-way ratchet, quiet hours) is exactly the "earned calm" architecture — but on current main it governs a minority of actual proactive traffic. Most proactive owner-facing output is prompt-cron tasks calling notify() directly (finance alone has five such tasks), bypassing budget, dedup, cooldown, and engagement tracking entirely; the sanctioned finance insight-scan runs once a month on day 30. There is no event-driven internal trigger of any kind (scheduler triggers are calendar/deadline only), so anomaly detection on ingested streams is polled at daily/monthly crons and the "time-critical" insight class gets exactly one delivery slot per day. Quiet hours exist twice (per-butler delivery_preferences, default open and configured by no butler; public.insight_settings for insights only) and the context bus dnd/sleeping signals gate nothing deterministically. Engagement learning is a crude 60-minute any-message heuristic with no per-category attribution, so the system cannot learn which kinds of nudges the owner values. A JARVIS acts within minutes of a signal, at moments the owner is receptive, through one accountable attention channel, and learns from every dismissal — the plumbing for all four exists here but is unwired.
audits.ideal: Every proactive owner-facing byte flows through one attention ledger with one owner-level policy (quiet hours, per-intent budgets, cross-fleet dedup) enforced deterministically at the Switchboard/Messenger boundary; domain butlers detect via fixed manifesto-scoped ingestion-event triggers (minutes, not days, of latency) but only ever propose — candidates compete for delivery at wake-anchored, context-bus-gated moments; every delivered nudge carries one-tap feedback that reweights its category; consequential preparation (drafted replies, staged events) is speculative but parked behind per-event approval, so the owner wakes to work already done and only ever taps "send".

findings.title: Most proactive traffic bypasses the insight broker — two disjoint proactivity systems
findings.evidence: roster/finance/butler.toml:106-155 — anomaly-digest (daily 21:00), budget-status-check, subscription-audit-monthly, upcoming-bills-check, subscription-renewal-alerts all instruct 'Use notify(channel="telegram", intent="send", ...)' directly, so they skip the budget/dedup/cooldown/engagement machinery of openspec/specs/proactive-insight-engine/spec.md entirely; RFC 0011's principle that butlers 'never deliver directly' (about/legends-and-lore/rfcs/0019-...md:40-48) is enforced only inside the pipeline that most proactive tasks don't use.
findings.detail: The anti-spam architecture is structural only for insight-scan jobs. Any prompt-cron task can notify() at will, so the global daily budget, cross-butler dedup, and the adaptive disengagement ratchet measure and govern a fraction of what the owner actually receives. This is the root cause behind noisy-fleet symptoms (e.g., the known calendar double-notify) recurring despite a fully built anti-spam engine.

findings.title: No fleet-wide quiet hours in practice: per-butler gate defaults open and no butler configures it
findings.evidence: openspec/specs/core-notify/spec.md 'Quiet Hours Delivery Gate' — 'no delivery_preferences row exists ... delivered immediately regardless of time or priority'; grep for delivery_preferences across roster/*/butler.toml and src/butlers/modules returns nothing, so no butler seeds a row; insight quiet hours live separately in public.insight_settings (proactive-insight-engine spec, Quiet Hours Suppression).
findings.detail: Quiet hours exist twice — per-butler (time-aware-delivery) and insight-pipeline (insight_settings) — and neither is authoritative for direct notify() traffic, which is ungated at 3am today. An owner-level single policy is missing.

findings.title: Context bus dnd/sleeping/traveling signals never gate delivery deterministically
findings.evidence: grep for get_active_context/user_context consumers in src/butlers: only src/butlers/core/spawner_context.py (prompt preamble injection) and api/routers/audit.py + audit models; neither the notify() quiet-hours gate nor _run_switchboard_insight_delivery_cycle_job (src/butlers/scheduled_jobs.py:162) consults the context bus.
findings.detail: RFC 0009's dnd signal is advisory-to-the-LLM only. Suppressing proactive delivery while the owner sleeps or is in dnd depends on the ephemeral session choosing to care — the opposite of vision.md Rule 4 (deterministic daemon) for the one place determinism matters most: not waking the owner.

findings.title: Zero event-driven internal triggers — anomaly detection is cron-polled with days of worst-case latency
findings.evidence: Scheduler trigger types are calendar_event_end / deadline_passed / deadline_threshold only (openspec/specs/event-chains/spec.md; src/butlers/core/scheduler.py:_parse_deadline_threshold_reference); nothing fires off public.ingestion_events. A spend spike ingested at 09:05 waits for the 21:00 anomaly-digest cron at best; via the sanctioned pipeline it waits for a monthly insight-scan plus the single daily insight-delivery-cycle at 08:00 (roster/switchboard/butler.toml:59-63).
findings.detail: The spec's own priority taxonomy defines 90-100 as 'time-critical (action needed within 24-48 hours)' yet grants that class exactly one delivery opportunity per day and no detection path faster than the owning butler's cron. RFC 0019 parks the owner-programmable rule engine, but fixed, code-defined, manifesto-scoped triggers that only spawn analysis sessions (no egress) are explicitly on the safe side of that line.

findings.title: Engagement signal is a 60-minute any-message heuristic — dismissal learning is impossible
findings.evidence: src/butlers/modules/pipeline.py:1499-1507 — on each ingress request, all insight_engagement rows delivered in the last 60 minutes flip to engaged=TRUE, regardless of which insight (or whether the message had anything to do with it); adaptation is a global budget shrink only (proactive-insight-engine spec, Adaptive Delivery).
findings.detail: There is no per-insight, per-category, or explicit-dismissal signal, so the system can never learn that the owner values finance anomalies but ignores reconnection nudges — it can only get globally quieter. The one-way ratchet punishes all categories for one boring category.

findings.title: Draft delivery intent is target-state plumbing with no producer anywhere
findings.evidence: openspec/specs/core-notify/spec.md:256-262 defines [TARGET-STATE] intent="draft" (Gmail draft, never sends); grep for needs_reply/draft producers across butler-switchboard and butler-messenger specs returns nothing — no capability detects reply-needed inbound messages or stages a draft.
findings.detail: RFC 0019 itself notes draft-then-review is 'more conservative than the status quo' and deliberately un-parked it, yet no spec exercises it. Speculative preparation — the highest-leverage proactivity form — has sanctioned plumbing and zero producers.

findings.title: Finance insight-scan cron runs only on day 30 of the month — never in February
findings.evidence: roster/finance/butler.toml:158-161 — cron = "0 7 30 * *" (07:00 on the 30th day of month), versus relationship daily (0 7 * * *) and health weekly; openspec/specs/butler-finance/spec.md does not mention insight-scan at all, so the cadence is unspecced and unreviewed.
findings.detail: The flagship anomaly-detection domain feeds the brokered pipeline roughly 11 times a year; everything timely goes out the direct-notify side door instead.

findings.title: No morning surface exists; briefing contributions are consumed only by the 23:00 SGT prep
findings.evidence: roster/general/butler.toml:49-100 — collect_briefing_contributions (cron 58 6) writes state consumed solely by eod-tomorrow-prep (cron 0 15 = 23:00 SGT); no schedule delivers a wake-time brief, and nothing couples delivery timing to the preferences:home_wake_time predicate (openspec/specs/user-preferences/spec.md) or the context-bus sleeping signal.
findings.detail: The insight digest fires at a fixed clock hour whether the owner is awake, asleep, or in another timezone; 'brief ready when the owner surfaces' — the canonical JARVIS moment — has all its ingredients (ingress hook, context bus, deferred_notifications) unassembled.

moves.title: One attention ledger: route ALL proactive owner-facing traffic through the broker with a single owner-level policy
moves.why: Makes RFC 0011's anti-spam guarantees actually cover what the owner receives. Converts finance/health prompt-cron digests from direct notify() into propose_insight_candidate() calls, and adds a deterministic attention ledger at the Switchboard notify boundary: one owner-level policy row (quiet hours, per-intent daily caps, cross-fleet dedup window) replacing the default-open per-butler delivery_preferences, plus a dashboard 'attention ledger' panel showing every delivery counted against budget — earned calm made auditable.
moves.integration_points: roster/finance/butler.toml:106-155 + roster/health/butler.toml prompt tasks (rewrite to propose candidates); src/butlers/modules/pipeline.py insight broker; notify tool in core (src/butlers/core, core-notify spec amendment: notify checks owner policy, not per-butler delivery_preferences); public.insight_settings generalized to an owner attention-policy table; deprecate per-butler delivery_preferences (time-aware-delivery spec amendment); dashboard /api surface for the ledger. Serves the Switchboard and Messenger infrastructure contracts (roster/messenger/MANIFESTO.md already asserts sole delivery ownership — this gives that ownership teeth).
moves.slice_plan: Slice 1: attention ledger table + notify-path counting and owner-level quiet hours (deterministic, no butler changes). Slice 2: convert finance's five direct-notify proactive tasks to insight candidates. Slice 3: dashboard ledger panel + retire delivery_preferences.

moves.title: Ingestion-event triggers (fixed, manifesto-scoped, non-egress) plus an urgent delivery sub-cycle
moves.why: Closes the detect-latency gap without touching RFC 0019's parked rule engine: butler.toml gains [[butler.trigger]] entries with trigger_type="ingestion_event" and a deterministic predicate over public.ingestion_events fields (source_channel, triage_target, e.g. finance transaction over threshold), debounced, dispatching an existing job/prompt whose only outputs are facts and insight candidates — no egress, not owner-programmable, declared in git like cron entries. Pair with an hourly urgent sub-cycle in insight_delivery_cycle that delivers only priority>=90 candidates (still budget- and quiet-hours-capped), so 'time-critical' means hours, not days.
moves.integration_points: src/butlers/core/scheduler.py (extend trigger detection beyond calendar/deadline; event_chains pattern as precedent), public.ingestion_events registry (openspec/specs/ingestion-event-registry), new [[butler.trigger]] toml schema + scheduled_tasks materialization, roster/finance/butler.toml + roster/health/butler.toml first adopters, switchboard insight_broker cadence (roster/switchboard/butler.toml:59-63, src/butlers/scheduled_jobs.py:162). Also fix finance insight-scan cron to daily. Serves finance manifesto (anomaly detection) and health manifesto (missed-dose detection: trigger on absence is slice 3 via a deadline-style check); needs a short RFC distinguishing this from RFC 0019's parked engine.
moves.slice_plan: Slice 1: urgent hourly sub-cycle in the delivery job (pure broker change). Slice 2: single hardcoded finance trigger (large-transaction event → anomaly_scan job, debounced 15 min). Slice 3: generalize to declared [[butler.trigger]] toml entries + spec.

moves.title: Per-category feedback loop: one-tap 'useful / mute this kind' on every delivered insight
moves.why: Answers 'learning notification preferences from dismissals' — the one proactivity dimension the adaptive ratchet cannot express. Digest items and standalone insights carry inline Telegram buttons (decision-loop RFC 0021 / bu-24lu6 provides the callback plumbing); taps write per-category weight rows that the delivery cycle multiplies into priority (and hard-mutes on request), replacing punish-everything-globally with targeted learning. Explicit attribution also supersedes the 60-minute any-message heuristic in pipeline.py:1499-1507 wherever a tap exists.
moves.integration_points: src/butlers/modules/pipeline.py delivery cycle + insight_engagement table (add category attribution + reaction columns); new public.insight_category_prefs table; telegram module callback handler (src/butlers/modules/telegram) reusing bu-24lu6 inline-keyboard infrastructure; proactive-insight-engine + insight-delivery spec amendments (RFC 0011 addendum). Dashboard: category weights visible on the Trust/insight settings surface. Serves the switchboard staffer contract (insight broker owner); no domain-manifesto change needed since it is owner-facing meta-preference.
moves.slice_plan: Slice 1: mute-category via existing message reply parsing (no buttons). Slice 2: inline buttons once bu-24lu6 keyboard plumbing lands. Slice 3: weight multipliers in ranking + dashboard surface.

moves.title: Speculative reply drafting: a producer for the sanctioned draft intent, parked behind one-tap approval
moves.why: The highest-value proactive act — 'the reply is already written, just tap send' — using only sanctioned machinery: Switchboard triage flags inbound messages as reply-needed, the routed domain butler drafts a reply in its session, and parks it via intent="draft" (core-notify spec:256-262, already TARGET-STATE, currently producer-less) or a pending_action delivering Send/Edit/Discard through the decision loop. Never auto-sends; RFC 0019 explicitly classifies draft-then-review and inline approval buttons as strengthening the per-event approval path.
moves.integration_points: roster/switchboard/.agents/skills/message-triage + signal-extraction (add reply-needed classification output); switchboard routing to carry the flag (src/butlers/modules/pipeline.py, RFC 0003 path); implement core-notify draft intent in the notify tool + messenger Gmail-draft tool (roster/messenger/modules); module-approvals pending_actions for telegram drafts with bu-24lu6 inline keyboards; new spec delta on butler-switchboard + core-notify. Serves the relationship manifesto (reconnection outreach planning — reconnect-planner skill can emit drafted openers) and the messenger contract (delivery stays messenger-owned); switchboard manifesto needs a one-line amendment for the reply-needed flag.
moves.slice_plan: Slice 1: implement the specced Gmail draft intent end-to-end (email only, owner reviews in Gmail — zero new UX). Slice 2: reply-needed triage flag + relationship/general butlers drafting on it. Slice 3: telegram staged drafts with one-tap Send via decision loop.

moves.title: Wake-anchored delivery: fire the morning digest on first owner activity, gated by the context bus
moves.why: Replaces clock-time delivery with receptive-moment delivery using parts that already exist: pipeline.py already intercepts every ingress for engagement tracking — add first-owner-activity-of-day detection (owner identity, owner-timezone calendar day) that triggers the insight delivery cycle and deferred_notifications flush, with a fixed owner-tz cron as fallback ceiling; make both the delivery cycle and the notify gate consult get_active_context() so sleeping/dnd deterministically suppress (fixing the context-bus-gates-nothing finding). The owner wakes, sends one message anywhere, and the brief + digest arrive — never at 3am, never while dnd.
moves.integration_points: src/butlers/modules/pipeline.py ingress hook (extend the engagement block at :1499); src/butlers/context_bus.py get_active_context consumed by scheduled_jobs.py:162 insight_delivery_cycle and by the notify quiet-hours gate; deferred_notifications flush path (time-aware-delivery spec); owner-timezone-context spec for day boundaries; optional new general-butler morning-brief schedule consuming briefing/combined state (roster/general/butler.toml) so contributions collected at 06:58 finally have a morning consumer. Serves the general butler's briefing mandate (roster/general/MANIFESTO.md) and RFC 0009's stated purpose for the sleeping/dnd signals.
moves.slice_plan: Slice 1: delivery cycle + notify gate consult context bus (deterministic dnd/sleeping suppression). Slice 2: first-activity trigger for the insight cycle with cron fallback. Slice 3: morning-brief task consuming existing briefing/combined state.

synthesis.headline: The 07-03 epic genuinely landed — timeline, issues, audit-log, spend, approvals, butler-detail, and secrets all climbed a tier and nothing broke — but every mechanism it shipped (judgment layer, command spine, event bus, state contract, keyboard triage) stopped at one or two surfaces, so the console reads as islands of excellence in an unmigrated sea. The deeper truth is one layer down: the frontend truth amnesty never reached the backend, where roughly a dozen aggregation endpoints still zero-fill on failure (butlers board, memory fan-out, notifications, approvals, settings, spend, secrets), letting dead sources render as healthy zeros under the very verdict banners built to prevent it. And the ecosystem's most consequential machinery — memory decay, the cross-butler discovery catalog, the insight broker's anti-spam — is fully built and effectively switched off.

themes.title: The truth amnesty stopped one layer above the backend: aggregation endpoints zero-fill on failure
themes.body: bu-86c4c.1/.2 fixed frontend error-as-empty, but the fan-out/aggregation layer beneath it still collapses failures into confident zeros returned as HTTP 200 with no degraded marker — so the very verdict banners the epic built assert calm over dead sources. This is the dominant NEW+NOT-LANDED defect class of the run, reproducing independently on at least 12 surfaces, and it is invisible to any frontend isError sweep because the fetch succeeds.
themes.exemplars: src/butlers/api/routers/butlers.py:497-503 (stripe failure → [0]*24, folded into aggregates); src/butlers/api/routers/memory.py:118-131 (pool failures summed away silently); frontend/src/components/system/SystemVerdictBanner.tsx:61-62 ('Instance healthy' rendered while backups/insights/posture queries are errored)

themes.title: Built once, never generalized: every epic mechanism has an adoption cliff
themes.body: The epic shipped correct mechanisms — command registry, keyboard triage, QueryBoundary, FetchingDim, event-cache registry, modal choreography, real-page axe tests — and each stopped at 1-3 consumers. Only Approvals and Issues register palette commands; the approvals j/k/a/d/x loop exists nowhere else and is advertised nowhere; FetchingDim has 3 consumers vs 46 forbidden animate-pulse sites; the event registry misses the notifications page's own query keys and calendar/education aren't on the bus at all; axe covers 3 of 38 pages. Nothing structural makes the primitive cheaper than the fork, so drift regenerates.
themes.exemplars: frontend/src/lib/command-registry.tsx:104 (useRegisterCommands: 2 importers repo-wide); frontend/src/hooks/event-cache-registry.ts:100-104 (notificationPatch skips ['notifications']/['notification-stats']); frontend/src/components/ui/fetching-dim.tsx:5 (3 consumers vs 46 animate-pulse sites)

themes.title: The judgment layer landed on 2 surfaces; 13+ open with static copy or raw counters
themes.body: bu-86c4c.17 put a synthesized verdict on /system and /butlers only. Approvals, sessions, notifications, qa, spend, ingestion, issues, calendar, education, chronicles, health, butler-detail, and audit-log all open with taglines or KPI grids — while the data for their verdicts is already fetched and, in several cases, rendered nowhere (QA's staffer_status/breaker/credentials, spend's projection_confidence, notifications' by_butler breakdown are all discarded on the client).
themes.exemplars: frontend/src/api/types.ts:4967-4990 vs QaOverviewPage.tsx:239-247 (staffer heartbeat fields fetched, never rendered); frontend/src/pages/SpendPage.tsx:80 (projection_confidence typed and discarded); frontend/src/pages/EducationPage.tsx:78-80 (static marketing tagline as the opener)

themes.title: The trace spine breaks at its hub nodes
themes.body: The .3/.4 spine work made signals into doors, but the destinations those doors converge on drop the spine: /sessions/:id (deep-linked from 10+ surfaces) renders no trace_id/request_id/parent/stderr; the audit reader deliberately withholds result/error/metadata (core_122 columns) so the ledger of record cannot say whether any action succeeded; timeline events never carry the trace_id sessions already persist; the ingestion event drawer cannot emit a trace outward; issue groups ('Seen 47x') have no path to their occurrences because the audit API lacks a result/group predicate.
themes.exemplars: frontend/src/pages/SessionDetailPage.tsx:134-263 (omits trace_id/request_id/parent/process_log); src/butlers/api/models/audit.py:58-63 ('intentionally left to a later PR'); src/butlers/api/audit_grouping.py:199-204 + routers/audit.py:291-316 (no result= predicate — group evidence unreachable)

themes.title: Dispatch is opt-in, not the default: the base layer is still shadcn
themes.body: The default typeface is the spec-forbidden system-ui/Roboto stack (Inter Tight is per-component opt-in that flagship pages never take); the shared page shell renders text-3xl font-bold h1s to 24 consumers; empty-state is icon+heading+cta against the one-serif-sentence spec; the same semantic gray has two values (--muted-foreground 0.556 vs --mfg 0.46, 1,378 vs 174 sites); butler hues collide 11-into-8 via modulo; chart color speaks four dialects. The in-flight lint (bu-86c4c.6) stops new drift but cannot flip runtime defaults — every new page is born off-language.
themes.exemplars: frontend/src/index.css:8 (root font-family system-ui/Roboto vs spec.md:143); frontend/src/components/ui/page.tsx:106 (text-3xl font-bold, 24 consumers); frontend/src/components/ui/ButlerMark.tsx:104-105 (idx % 8 → qa=chronicler, relationship=education, travel=finance)

themes.title: Component-local filter state severs the inbound half of clause-is-a-door
themes.body: Outbound doors landed, but the pages they point at hold filters in useState with no URL form, so the system's own attention links dump the owner on unfiltered streams: the dashboard's 'N failed notifications' links bare /notifications, Trust Console's 'Full audit log' drops its privileged predicate, a shared timeline URL loses every facet, and no surface can ever deep-link a filtered view of notifications/timeline/issues. Filtered views are also unshareable, un-bookmarkable, and palette-unaddressable.
themes.exemplars: frontend/src/pages/NotificationsPage.tsx:75 (filters in useState, no useSearchParams anywhere in file); frontend/src/components/overview/model.ts:511 (attention row href='/notifications', no ?status=failed); frontend/src/pages/TimelinePage.tsx:76-78 (facets/view in plain useState while ?event drawer param survives contextless)

themes.title: Shipped but dormant: the ecosystem's judgment machinery is built and switched off
themes.body: The substrate-level counterpart of the UI themes: memory decay/fading/expiry code exists and is wired to nothing (0 fading, 0 expired rows live; the spec-required sweep has never run, so every confidence number shown is an un-decayed write-time value); 4 of 9 memory butlers never consolidate (switchboard: 4,148 pending episodes vs 44 facts); the cross-butler discovery catalog has spec+table+tools and 0 rows; RFC 0011's anti-spam budget/dedup governs only insight-scan traffic while finance alone runs five direct-notify cron tasks around it; quiet hours default open and no butler configures them.
themes.exemplars: src/butlers/modules/memory/storage.py:2354 (run_decay_sweep in no job registry, no schedule, no tool); src/butlers/modules/memory/__init__.py:185 + public.memory_catalog count=0 (enable_shared_catalog false everywhere); roster/finance/butler.toml:106-155 (five proactive tasks bypassing the broker via direct notify())

ranked_moves.title: Honest aggregation: purge server-side zero-fill and adopt the degraded envelope fleet-wide
ranked_moves.what: Extend the repo's own aggregates_available convention to every fan-out/aggregation endpoint: butlers board (stripe failure → stripe_unavailable flag, cron failure → cadence 'unknown' not false-OVERDUE), memory fan-out (pools_failed in meta), notifications list/stats (source_available), approvals flat/history (sources_degraded), settings header_counts (nullable fields), secrets breaks-catalogue (degraded flag), spend summary/breakdown (unavailable_butlers). Then gate every verdict/all-clear renderer — SystemVerdictBanner, NeedsYouStrip, plex flanks, spend movers — on isError + degraded flags so calm is never asserted over failed or partial sources.
ranked_moves.why: North star: 'no number is ever fabricated; every degraded source names itself; no failed fetch ever impersonates an empty queue.' This is the run's dominant defect class — the truth amnesty (bu-86c4c.1/.2) fixed the frontend while the backend still fabricates calm on ~12 surfaces, invisible to any client-side sweep because the fetch returns 200.
ranked_moves.evidence: src/butlers/api/routers/butlers.py:497-503 ([0]*24 on stripe failure) and :480-488 (cron failure → false OVERDUE); src/butlers/api/routers/memory.py:118-131; src/butlers/api/routers/notifications.py:93-111; src/butlers/api/routers/approvals.py:1546-1548; src/butlers/api/routers/settings_console.py:137-282; SystemVerdictBanner.tsx:61-62 ('Instance healthy' over errored sources); NeedsYouStrip.tsx:59-67 ('All N healthy' when liveness is unknowable); SpendPage.tsx:1377-1381 (movers fabricate '+$X · new' from a half-failed comparison).
ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) Shared envelope helper + convention doc (extend CLAUDE.md Degraded-Mode section); 2) per-router sweeps as independent PRs (butlers, memory, notifications, approvals, spend, settings, secrets), each with a contract test that a raising source yields degraded flags, never zeros; 3) verdict/all-clear gating on system/butlers/plex/spend renderers; 4) frontend em-dash + named-source rendering via the existing SourceDegradedNote vocabulary.

ranked_moves.title: Confirmed-lies hotfix batch: seven verified fabrications, each a few lines
ranked_moves.what: One sprint of ≤S fixes for lies confirmed at decision points: QA PRPanel 'No PR. Escalated to user.' rendered for every in-flight case + pulse strip coloring findings_dispatched patrols clean-green (status string mismatch) + silent 25-row rail cap; butler-detail Errors KPI structurally hardwired to 0 (counts a trigger_source value that cannot exist); secrets PageSystem green plaque over failing state + fabricated 0ms probe latency + audit link that 422s (missing s: prefix); notifications 'Retried' filter that can never match a row; spend live-MTD double-counting against its own polling baseline; timeline dead-API-impersonates-idle (stale strip when head poll fails after first paint).
ranked_moves.why: Each is a confirmed fabrication — the purest violation of earned calm — at the exact moment the owner decides whether to act, and each fix is mechanically small. Doctrine: trust defects outrank everything at this cost.
ranked_moves.evidence: PRPanel.tsx:26-31 + CaseDossier.tsx:150-157 (stage available, unused); QaOverviewPage.tsx:292-296 vs src/butlers/api/routers/qa.py:1631-1637 ('dispatched' vs 'findings_dispatched'); ButlerActivityTab.tsx:301-307 vs core/sessions.py:25; secrets pages.tsx:1648-1649, :1139/:1762 (latencyMs:0), :1928; NotificationsPage.tsx:40-47 vs notifications.py:149-186; SpendPage.tsx:1243-1260; use-timeline-ledger.ts:131-133.
ranked_moves.slice_plan: File as one batch bead with seven independent commits; each carries a regression test pinning the honest behavior (e.g. state='failed' system credential renders red plaque; findings_dispatched dot renders amber; MTD counter resets on forecast resolution).

ranked_moves.title: Wire the memory lifecycle: decay sweep runs, consolidation is module-default, backlog drains
ranked_moves.what: Register run_decay_sweep as a scheduled-job handler and have the memory module self-register default maintenance schedules (decay, consolidation, episode cleanup, superseded purge) on startup for all 9 butlers — toml overrides cadence, not existence. Drain the 6,500+ pending-episode backlog (switchboard 4,148, finance 1,294, education 1,137) with a bounded catch-up job, and swap the ivfflat lists=20 indexes (built on empty tables) to HNSW while touching migrations.
ranked_moves.why: Substrate-level fabrication: docs/modules/memory.md and the memory-retention-policy spec promise a decay sweep that has never run anywhere, so every confidence value the console displays is an un-decayed write-time number masquerading as a maintained one, and 4/9 butlers promote nothing to durable facts. Turning on shipped machinery is the highest value-per-cost ecosystem move available.
ranked_moves.evidence: src/butlers/modules/memory/storage.py:2354 (run_decay_sweep absent from _MEMORY_MAINTENANCE_JOB_HANDLERS at scheduled_jobs.py:378-381, no toml schedule, no tool); live dev DB: 0 fading, 0 expired rows; roster grep: only 5 of 9 butlers schedule consolidation; migrations/001_memory_schema.py:84,203,330 (ivfflat lists=20 at empty-table creation).
ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) memory_decay_sweep handler + schedules in the 5 already-cron'd butlers (ships alone); 2) module-default schedule registration in on_startup + delete copy-paste toml blocks; 3) bounded consolidation backfill respecting dead_letter states; 4) HNSW migration + nightly synthetic-scale recall harness; spec delta to memory-retention-policy declaring jobs module-default.

ranked_moves.title: Dashboard coherence: one liveness model, one decision safety contract
ranked_moves.what: Move the Overview onto GET /api/butlers/board's canonical server verdict (delete model.ts's private status sets, 5-minute threshold, and the two dead queries — the event bus already live-patches the board key), and fold the approvals undo window (scheduleDecision/UNDO_WINDOW_MS) into the shared useApprovalDecisionMutations hook so dashboard rows, /approvals, and the upcoming chat widget inherit the identical grace-window contract.
ranked_moves.why: 'One instrument built by one hand': the flagship page currently renders contradictory liveness verdicts against /butlers in the same instant (and its KPI contradicts its own attention list), and the identical approve verb is undoable on /approvals but fires an irreversible tool execution on a single click on the page the owner lands on first.
ranked_moves.evidence: frontend/src/components/overview/model.ts:151-153,271-311 (private HEALTHY/DEGRADED/OFFLINE sets + own stale threshold) vs use-butler-status-board.ts:1-15 (canonical cadence-aware verb); event-cache-registry.ts:79-93 (patches ['butlers','board'] but not the dashboard's keys); DashboardPage.tsx:139-141 (direct mutate) vs ApprovalsPage.tsx:1308-1325 (undo window).
ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) model.ts accepts BoardRow[] (pure-function tests first); 2) DashboardPage swaps hooks, deletes dead queries, KPI consumes board verdict; 3) extract scheduleDecision into use-approval-decisions behind an option, ApprovalsPage consumes it behavior-identically; 4) dashboard rows opt in with inline 'Approving in 5s · Undo' state.

ranked_moves.title: One session dossier on the trace spine, live for running sessions
ranked_moves.what: Merge SessionDetailPage and SessionDetailDrawer into a single Dispatch-grade SessionDossier rendering every SessionDetail field the store holds — trace_id → /timeline, request_id → /sessions?request=, parent_session_id link, complexity, resolution_source, cost, and process_log stderr/exit_code as the named root evidence for failures. Always fetch via global getSession (delete the ?butler= dual path and the 'try adding ?butler=name to the URL' copy), collapse to one bus-invalidated query key so the palette's own trigger→session flow stops landing on a frozen 'Running' page, and mirror list selection to ?selected=.
ranked_moves.why: The trace-id spine is only as strong as its busiest hub: 10+ surfaces deep-link to /sessions/:id, where the owner arrives asking 'why did this fail' and finds no trace, no stderr, no parent, and a page that never updates while a session runs — detect works, diagnose dead-ends.
ranked_moves.evidence: SessionDetailPage.tsx:134-263 (omits trace_id/request_id/parent/process_log despite types.ts:221-268 carrying all of them); inbound links from SpendPage.tsx:719, ApprovalsPage.tsx:670, TimelineLedger.tsx:76, notification-feed.tsx:174 et al.; event-cache-registry.ts:88-92 invalidates only ['session-detail', butler, id] while GlobalActionsRegistrar.tsx:36 navigates to the un-invalidated global key.
ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) Extract SessionDossier from the drawer content with full field set + stderr disclosure; 2) rebuild SessionDetailPage as a Page-archetype wrapper on it, one global query key, bus-invalidated; 3) running-session elapsed ticker + streaming tool-call tail; 4) ?selected= URL mirroring + j/k/[/]/y keyboard loop on the list.

ranked_moves.title: The ledger tells the truth: audit outcome trio + issue-group occurrences
ranked_moves.what: Project result/error/metadata (persisted since core_122) through the audit reader, API model, and table — Outcome column in the three state colors, error text and metadata in the detail row, failure rows linking to their /issues group. Add result= and group= predicates to GET /api/audit-log (or GET /api/issues/{key}/occurrences reusing the shared CTE) so 'Seen 47x' finally opens its 47 occurrences with session/request_id links. Default the page to kind=privileged (backend predicate already exists), fix Trust Console's link to carry it, and render the detail expansion under its row instead of at the table bottom.
ranked_moves.why: The audit log is the root of the evidence spine and it currently cannot say whether any audited operation succeeded — while the issues feed built ON result='error' rows offers no path to them. 'Root evidence one keystroke away' dead-ends one hop before the truth on both surfaces.
ranked_moves.evidence: src/butlers/api/models/audit.py:58-63 ('intentionally left to a later PR'); routers/audit.py:398,439 (projections omit the trio) and :291-316 (no result/group predicate); audit_grouping.py:199-204 (multi-butler groups emit bare /audit-log); AuditLogTable.tsx:131-253 (detail row appended after the entire map); SettingsPermissionsPage.tsx:459 (privileged predicate dropped mid-drill).
ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) Reader/model/type projection + Outcome column + adjacent detail row (coordinate DisclosureRow with bu-f310e); 2) result=/group= predicate + full-predicate links from audit_grouping; 3) issues rows gain DisclosureRow expansion with occurrences + ButlerMark chips; 4) kind=privileged default + noise toggle + Trust Console link fix.

ranked_moves.title: Flip the Dispatch base layer: defaults, not opt-ins
ranked_moves.what: Make the language the default in one coordinated pass: root font-family → var(--font-sans) (killing the spec-forbidden system-ui/Roboto default); rewrite ui/page.tsx headings to Display/Title 500 and ui/empty-state.tsx to the one-serif-sentence spec (~48 consumers inherit conformance); alias the shadcn token names to Dispatch values in index.css (--muted-foreground→--mfg, --card→--bg-elev, --destructive→--red — 1,378 sites snap to canonical values in one diff); explicit 11-slot butler-hue map ending the modulo collisions, spec table generated from the constant; extend chart-colors.ts to four semantic channels (series/butler-identity/category/neutral-density-ramp) and migrate the raw-hex charts; retire skeleton-pulse for FetchingDim + static placeholders.
ranked_moves.why: 'One instrument built by one hand' cannot be lint-enforced onto a base layer that defaults off-language — every un-redesigned surface and every 3am page is born wrong. This single move does more for fleet-wide coherence than any per-page reskin, and it hands bu-86c4c.6 a clean baseline instead of day-one suppressions.
ranked_moves.evidence: index.css:8 (system-ui/Roboto root default vs spec.md:143; index.css:247-249 admits opt-in); ui/page.tsx:106 (text-3xl font-bold, 24 consumers); index.css:29 vs :109 (two grays for one role, 1,378 vs 174 sites); ButlerMark.tsx:51-105 (11 butlers into 8 slots); MasteryTrendChart.tsx:55-56 #3b82f6, hex-heatmap.ts:33-37 (state ramp repurposed for density); 46 animate-pulse sites vs fetching-dim.tsx's 3 consumers.
ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) Root font + page.tsx heading unification + empty-state rewrite; 2) token aliasing + contrast-test updates; 3) butler-hue registry + collision test + spec table sync; 4) chart registry channels + education/chronicles/topology migration; 5) skeleton retirement + animate-pulse added to the .6 forbidden list.

ranked_moves.title: One attention ledger: all proactive owner egress through the broker
ranked_moves.what: Route every proactive owner-facing byte through RFC 0011's machinery: convert the direct-notify prompt-cron tasks (finance's five, health's digests) into insight candidates; add a deterministic owner-level attention policy (quiet hours, per-intent daily budgets, cross-fleet dedup, same-window coalescing into one composed Dispatch-voice message) enforced at the Switchboard/Messenger notify boundary; make the delivery cycle and notify gate consult the context bus (dnd/sleeping) deterministically; add an hourly urgent sub-cycle so priority≥90 means hours, not one daily slot.
ranked_moves.why: Earned calm must hold at the phone, not just the console: the anti-spam architecture is structural for a minority of traffic, quiet hours default open and no butler configures them, and the observed calendar double-notify is one instance of the missing arbiter, not its extent. Extends beyond bu-24lu6 (which adds pushes) — this is the governance layer under them.
ranked_moves.evidence: roster/finance/butler.toml:106-155 (five tasks instructing direct notify(), bypassing budget/dedup/cooldown); core-notify spec quiet-hours gate defaults-open + zero delivery_preferences rows fleet-wide; grep: context-bus consumed only by spawner_context.py — the notify gate never checks dnd; roster/switchboard/butler.toml:59-63 (one insight delivery slot/day for 'time-critical').
ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) Attention ledger table + owner-level quiet hours + notify-path counting (deterministic, no butler changes); 2) context-bus gating of delivery cycle + notify; 3) convert finance's five tasks to candidates; 4) same-window coalescing + urgent hourly sub-cycle; 5) dashboard attention-ledger panel under Trust Console; RFC amending 0011 + Messenger/Switchboard contracts.

ranked_moves.title: Verdict-opener rollout: a shared, degradation-honest DispatchVerdict primitive
ranked_moves.what: Extract SystemVerdictBanner's composition pattern into one shared primitive — deterministic template, clauses as typed doors, any degraded input names itself or suppresses the all-clear — and adopt it as the opener on approvals ('3 waiting; nearest expires in 40m; one approved action never ran'), sessions (failure clustering), notifications (windowed by_butler verdict), qa (staffer masthead from fields already fetched), spend (pace + confidence + top mover), ingestion, issues, butler-detail, and calendar. No LLM cost — pure composition from data each page already fetches.
ranked_moves.why: The north star's signature property — 'every surface opens with the system's own synthesized verdict, and every clause of that prose is a door' — landed on exactly two surfaces. Nine agents independently proposed the same move because the inputs are already on the wire and, on qa/spend/notifications, literally discarded.
ranked_moves.evidence: types.ts:4967-4990 (staffer_status/last/next patrol/breaker/credentials fetched, unrendered at QaOverviewPage.tsx:239-247); SpendPage.tsx:80 (projection_confidence discarded before render); notification-stats-bar.tsx:90-99 (by_butler thrown away); EducationPage.tsx:78-80 (static tagline).
ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) Extract primitive + variants (skeleton/all-clear/problems) with the isError-suppression contract from move 1; 2) adopt on qa + approvals + spend (highest-stakes, data-ready); 3) sessions/notifications (needs small aggregate facets); 4) ingestion/issues/calendar/butler-detail; each adoption is an independent S/M PR.

ranked_moves.title: One overlay contract + shell announcer: fix the fake-modal command palette
ranked_moves.what: Extract useModalChoreography (focus-in, trap, Escape, focus-restore, sr-only status region) from the ingestion EventDrawer and apply it to EntityFinder — currently a raw div overlay with no dialog role that leaks Tab focus behind its own scrim and never restores focus — plus TimelineEventDrawer, CalendarAgendaView (aria-modal with no trap: worse than no ARIA), and ButlerManagementTab. Add one shell-level sr-only aria-live region announcing stream state edges, route changes, and new-event counts (and render LiveIndicator on mobile, where the degraded-stream signal currently vanishes). Lint hand-rolled fixed-inset overlays; generalize the real-page axe pattern into a route-registry-driven sweep over all 38 pages.
ranked_moves.why: The console's single most important surface fails basic dialog semantics, and 'every degraded source names itself' is currently visual-only — SR users never hear the fleet stream drop. The correct implementations exist in-repo once each; this makes them mechanisms.
ranked_moves.evidence: EntityFinder.tsx:431-453 (no role=dialog/aria-modal, Tab leak when activeResult null, no focus restore); CalendarAgendaView.tsx:44-48; LiveIndicator.tsx:56-69 (silent swaps, hidden sm:inline-flex); 3 of 38 pages have axe tests (ButlersPage/ButlerDetailPage/TimelineTab only); EventDrawer.tsx:554-575 as the gold-standard donor.
ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) Extract hook + migrate EntityFinder (keep Tab=hop on entity rows only, fix activeResult tracking); 2) migrate the three other overlays; 3) shell announcer fed by useEventStream edges + Page title effect + NewEventsPill; 4) overlay lint entry; 5) registry-driven axe suite with skip-manifest burn-down.

ranked_moves.title: Shortcut registry + fleet palette adoption: an unadvertised shortcut becomes structurally impossible
ranked_moves.what: Add binding metadata to PaletteCommand and ship useRegisterShortcut — one hook that both installs page-scoped keys (with the editable-field guard, subsuming bu-5o22a, extended to SELECT/contentEditable/open-modal suspension) and publishes them to the '?' sheet ('On this page' section) and the palette's inline kbd column. Make the palette browsable (recents + verbs at empty query, shared fuzzy scorer), migrate the approvals j/k/a/d/x and ChatPanel chords onto it, delete MemorySearch's dead colliding '/' handler, extract useListTriage from Approvals for Dashboard/Issues/Notifications rows, and register verbs on the ten verb-mute surfaces (calendar, memory, secrets, qa, spend, health, education, butler-detail, settings, chronicles).
ranked_moves.why: 'The first use needs no docs, the tenth needs no mouse': the one-command-spine landed as infrastructure and 2 of ~25 pages adopted it; the product's best interaction (approvals triage) is a secret advertised nowhere; the fleet's richest workspace (calendar) has one keydown handler in 6,472 lines.
ranked_moves.evidence: command-registry.tsx:36-45 (no binding field) and :104 (2 importers); ApprovalsPage.tsx:1332-1374 (keys, zero hints anywhere); use-keyboard-shortcuts.ts:41-45 vs MemorySearch.tsx:82-96 ('/' double-fire); EntityFinder.tsx:366-375 (verbs hidden until first keystroke, no recents); CalendarWorkspacePage.tsx:2017 (sole keydown).
ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) binding field + useRegisterShortcut + help-sheet section + palette kbd column; 2) migrate approvals/chat, delete the '/' collision, add u=undo; 3) recents store + fuzzy scorer + empty-query verbs; 4) useListTriage extraction + Dashboard/Issues/Notifications adoption with a shared footer hint strip; 5) per-page verb registration sweep (each page an S PR); complements in-flight bu-86c4c.15 (verbs) without overlap — this is reachability.

ranked_moves.title: API-direct inference lane + purpose-tagged spend attribution
ranked_moves.what: Add an 'api' runtime adapter (direct provider tool-use call, no CLI subprocess) and flip the discretion/classification catalog tiers onto it — connector screening and switchboard routing return in model-time instead of paying cold CLI+MCP bootstrap, halving the two-serial-spawn latency of every interactive reply. Simultaneously make that spend honest: add a purpose dimension to public.token_usage_ledger, fix the classifier's trigger_source 'tick'→'classification' (it currently makes spend rules targeting {trigger:'route'} silently never match), and give discretion calls per-connector identity instead of '__discretion__' with NULL session_id.
ranked_moves.why: A JARVIS answers in conversational time and accounts for every token: today every thought is a heavyweight subprocess and the highest-volume calls are the least attributed — /spend cannot price one inbound Telegram message, and classification spend masquerades as scheduler ticks. Vision rule 4 intact: judgment stays in LLM calls, only the transport gets cheap.
ranked_moves.evidence: core/runtimes/claude_code.py:439 (subprocess per invoke); discretion_dispatcher.py:226-239 (1-turn screens on the same path, mcp_servers={}), :106/:251-258 ('__discretion__', session_id=None); modules/pipeline.py:1979-1984 (trigger_source='tick' on classification); model_routing.py:481-483 (trigger constraints fail-closed on None).
ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) Adapter + tests behind an unreferenced catalog entry; 2) flip discretion tiers, verify connector screening; 3) classifier structured-tool-use fast lane with CLI fallback; 4) ledger purpose column + both write paths + trigger_source rename with fixture sweep; 5) surface purpose in /spend drill-down and rules.

ranked_moves.title: URL-backed filters + predicate-carrying inbound doors on the triage surfaces
ranked_moves.what: Migrate filter state to useSearchParams on notifications, timeline (facets/view/butlers — the drawer's ?event already is), issues (plus a default 7d window and severity/butler pills with a capped CTE), and health measurements (?type=); collapse audit-log's dual filter state (the ?actor param silently overriding the visible input) into one URL-serialized state. Then make the system's own inbound clauses carry their predicates: dashboard 'N failed notifications' → /notifications?status=failed, Trust Console 'Full audit log' → ?kind=privileged, stat tiles become filter anchors, and off-page ?event deep links resolve honestly instead of rendering nothing.
ranked_moves.why: Clause-is-a-door fails inbound across six surfaces: the console hands the owner links that dump them on unfiltered streams, filtered views are unshareable and palette-unaddressable, and one page shows data its own controls deny.
